title: Relationships
tagline: Build relationships naturally and organically in a world where every character is unique
description:
Relationships allows you to establish and build relationships in a way that feels natural and organic in a SkyrimNet-driven world. Every character has a unique combination of traits and attributes that make them behave and react to you in their own way.

Some characters fall deeply in love but want to save themselves for marriage, while others shun commitment but are open to dating with no strings attached. Getting to know them and treating them accordingly is the whole point, just as in real life. Settings give you control over how quickly relationships progress. Relationships can also regress as warranted.

This applies to both romantic and platonic relationships. Deciding to progress to a romantic relationship requires mutual consent. A successful marriage proposal requires progressing to the highest tier.

Optionally integrates with its companion mod Kinship, so your significant other(s) and children are aware of their relationships to one another and act accordingly. Settings can ensure that your children are blocked from having romantic relations but can still grow their platonic bond.

Requires:
- SkyrimNet Beta 25+
- SKSE64
- Address Library for SKSE Plugins
- PapyrusUtil SE
- powerofthree's Papyrus Extender
- Papyrus MessageBox (Nexus 83578; required for the consent prompt; bundled by MARAS)

Optionally supports:
- Kinship ( for awareness of familial ties )
- M.A.R.A.S. ( for marriage )
- OStim Community Resource ( for attractiveness rating )
- SeverActions ( for custom bio blocks )
- Merdian UI (non-VR users only)
- Prisma UI

Contains no adult content.
author: deadohiosky
changelog:
**Relationships' custom bio blocks now auto-populated**
With SeverActions 4.0.1 or newer, everyone enrolled in Relationships automatically have the mod's custom bio blocks selected by the LLM and applied. This adds more character definition that helps the LLM roleplay their unique personalities. User-chosen/removed blocks always take precedence.

**Everyone you talk to gets enrolled in Relationships**
Named people you talk to can join your roster. Guards and other unnamed passers-by aren't. Anyone you remove stays removed. Opt-in feature - turn it on in the plugin settings.

**Dashboard now supports Magelight UI**
If you have SeverActions 4.x, you already have Magelight (can also be obtained standalone via Nexus), and the dashboard uses it when Meridian UI isn't installed. In Skyrim VR it's tried first. Prisma UI is the fallback.

**New API for mod authors**
For other mod authors: a read-only C++ API that lets your SKSE plugin see each bond's tier, track, commitment, and more, with a callback when they change. See `For other mod authors` in the GitHub README.
